dataset: USGS: Estimated county level domestic well population with arsenic > 10 µg/L (Ayotte, Medalie & Qi, 2017)
Minnesota County Well Index (MGS/MDH), non-public-supply wells
filter: USE_C = 'DO' (domestic)

dataset: Michigan EGLE Wellogic water wells
filter: WELL_TYPE = 'HOSHLD' (household)

dataset: California DWR Well Completion Reports (OSWCR)
filter: Planned use 'Water Supply Domestic', record type 'New'

dataset: Well Construction Reports (Well Log Database), Washington Department of Ecology
filter: WellProjectType='Water' and WellSubType in ('Water (Cased)','Water (Dug)') (water-supply wells; no domestic-only field exists)

dataset: Maine Well Database (Maine Geological Survey, Dept. of Agriculture, Conservation & Forestry)
filter: WELL_USE in ('DOMESTIC','FARM, DOMESTIC'), geothermal and observation excluded

dataset: Private Well Tracking System (Private Well Facilities layer), Iowa Department of Natural Resources
filter: No use field: layer is the Iowa DNR Private Well Tracking System (private wells = household supply wells); all opStatus values included

dataset: Arkansas Water Well Construction Database (public layer), Arkansas Department of Agriculture - Natural Resources Division
filter: use_cd_x='DO' (Domestic use code in Arkansas Water Well Construction Database)

dataset: Well completion report sites (delegated counties + District issued permits), St. Johns River Water Management District (SJRWMD), Florida
filter: WELL_USE='Domestic' (SJRWMD well completion report sites; delegated-county + district-issued permit layers merged, deduped on STN_ID)

dataset: MassDEP Well Driller Program well completion reports (Well Location Viewer data, snapshot 26 Apr 2023)
filter: Well_Type='Domestic', Work_Performed<>'Decommission', no Error_Flag

dataset: Virginia Water Wells (VA_Water_Wells), Virginia Department of Energy, Division of Geology and Mineral Resources (compiled from DEQ GW-2, VDH, USGS, WWCR records)
filter: Function_='Domestic' (exact; excludes 'Industrial and Domestic', Farm, Public, Municipal etc.; Use_ free-text ignored)

dataset: IN DNR Water Well Records (Water Well Record Database), Indiana Department of Natural Resources, Division of Water
filter: NO use field in the Indiana DNR record layer; heuristic residential proxy: owner name has no business/utility/government/institution keyword, casing diameter <= 6 in (or missing), pump rate <= 100 gpm (or missing)

dataset: Oklahoma Water Resources Board groundwater well records
filter: use_class='Domestic'

dataset: Water Resource Sites database (ground-water site inventory, domestic wells), North Dakota Department of Water Resources (formerly State Water Commission)
filter: Purpose='Domestic Well' (Water Resource Sites inventory, site download sites.txt; MN-/MT- out-of-state sites dropped)

dataset: Pennsylvania DCNR PaGWIS water wells
filter: Water_Use='DOMESTIC' (layer holds 9 duplicated OID blocks; only first block OID<26713000 read, then deduped on PAWellID)

dataset: Water Wells (Wellhead Information Management System, certified water wells), Missouri Department of Natural Resources - Missouri Geological Survey
url: https://gis.dnr.mo.gov/host/rest/services/geology/water_wells/MapServer/1 (Missouri DNR 'Water Wells' open-data layer, GIS Hub CSV export)
filter: WELL_TYPE='Domestic' (WIMS well types: Domestic, High Yield, Public, Multi-Family)

dataset: NR68 Water Well Completion Reports (well logs, public layer), South Dakota Department of Agriculture and Natural Resources - Water Rights Program
filter: WELL_TYPE='DOM' (Domestic)

dataset: Ground Water Information Center (GWIC) database, Montana Bureau of Mines and Geology (Montana Tech)
filter: GWIC Well Use layer well_use='DOMESTIC' AND priority=1 (primary use), joined on gwicid to Boreholes site_type='WELL'

dataset: Wells (well driller's reports), Idaho Department of Water Resources
filter: WellUse in Domestic, Domestic-Single Residence, Domestic-Multiple Residence, Domestic-Multiple Individual Users, Domestic-Livestock (excludes Domestic-Public Water Supply; 54% of records have blank WellUse and are excluded)

dataset: Registered Groundwater Wells (Groundwater Wells DWEE), Nebraska Department of Water, Energy and Environment (formerly DNR)
url: https://www.nebraskamap.gov/datasets/nebraska::groundwater-wells-dwee (ArcGIS Hub CSV export of item a50ccf265ab94efb8f7b2e809992ee2a; service gis.ne.gov/agency3/rest/services/Groundwater_Wells_DWEE/FeatureServer/0)
filter: WellUseDescription='Domestic'

dataset: Water Wells (RBDMS-ENV water well database), Geological Survey of Alabama
filter: FacilityType='Domestic' (case-insensitive) in GSA RBDMS-ENV Water Wells layer; depth from Construct table (WELL_DEPTH ft), static level / pumping rate / year from each well's earliest WaterLevel record

dataset: Private Wells / Well Completion Reports (Vermont DEC Drinking Water & Groundwater Protection Division, ANR; via VCGI open data)
filter: WellUseCode='Domestic', excluding WellReasonCode Geothermal and Test/Exploration/Monitoring

dataset: Well Reports (Water Well Log database), Oregon Water Resources Department
filter: primary_use='Domestic' and type_of_log='Water Well'

dataset: MS Water Permit Wells / Water Well Records (Nov 2024), Mississippi DEQ Office of Land and Water Resources, published by MARIS (Mississippi Automated Resource Information System)
filter: Beneficial='DO' (DOMESTIC (HOME) WELL)

dataset: Well Log Tracking System (WELTS), Alaska Department of Natural Resources, Division of Mining, Land and Water
filter: WellUse='Domestic' (about 70% of WELTS logs have no WellUse recorded and are excluded)

dataset: Nevada Division of Water Resources (NDWR) Well Driller Reports
filter: ProposedUse='Domestic' AND WorkType IN ('New','Replacement Well')

dataset: Kentucky Water Wells and Springs (Kentucky Groundwater Data Repository), Kentucky Geological Survey, University of Kentucky
filter: primary_use LIKE 'Domestic%' (Domestic - Single Household; Domestic - Multiple Domestic Households) and GWSourceType = W (wells, springs excluded)

dataset: ILWATER Water and Related Wells (Illinois water well records), Illinois State Geological Survey (Prairie Research Institute, University of Illinois)
filter: WELL_TYPE='PRIV' (Private Water Well; excludes Semi-Private, Household-Livestock, municipal, irrigation, monitoring, geothermal, test holes)

dataset: New Mexico Office of the State Engineer (OSE) Points of Diversion (well records from driller logs)
filter: use_ IN ('DOM','DOL','PDM','PDL') = 72-12-1 domestic one household, domestic+livestock, and non-72-12-1 domestic / domestic+livestock; excludes pod_status CLW (changed location of well)

dataset: Water Wells (NYSDEC Water Well Contractor Program completion reports, since April 2000) via NY GIS Clearinghouse
filter: WELLTYPE in ('Domestic','domestic supply') exact (mixed-use strings like Domestic/Irrigation excluded; geothermal excluded)

dataset: Coastal Plain Well Inventory (SCDNR_Coastal_Plain_Well_Inventory), South Carolina Department of Natural Resources / SC Dept of Environmental Services Hydrology
filter: WELL_USE='DOM' (domestic)

dataset: Texas Water Development Board Submitted Driller Reports
filter: ProposedUse='Domestic' and WellType not 'Reconditioning' (TWDB Submitted Driller Reports; depth = BoreholeDepthFt; no static level or yield fields)

dataset: NHDES / NH Geological Survey Water Well Inventory (well completion reports)
filter: USE_ in ('DOMESTIC','DOMESTIC DRINKING WATER') (excludes geothermal, test, ag, community supply, municipal etc.)

dataset: Wisconsin Well Inventory (Well Construction Reports, private wells), Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources
filter: WELL_USE='PRIVATE POTABLE' from SOURCE_DATABASE='WELL CONSTRUCTION' (private well construction reports; excludes private non-potable, monitoring, loop/heat exchange, public/municipal, high-capacity)

dataset: Non-Public Wells permit database (DNREC Division of Water, Residential Services; Delaware Environmental Navigator) via FirstMap
filter: WellType='Domestic - Standard' and WellStatus in (Active, Completed)

dataset: Arizona Department of Water Resources well registry
filter: WATER_USE='DOMESTIC' (exact, excludes combined-use strings) and not WELL_CANCELLED='Y'

dataset: Ohio DNR water well log records
filter: WELL_USE='DOMESTIC'

dataset: Colorado Division of Water Resources (DWR) well permits (CDSS REST API)
filter: associatedUses contains Domestic or Household use only, with no Commercial/Industrial/Municipal/Augmentation/Geothermal/Dewatering/Monitoring/Irrigation-free-of-domestic etc. (Domestic+Stock/Irrigation allowed); excludes application/permit-stage records never built; deduped on permit number

dataset: Wyoming State Engineer's Office (SEO) groundwater well permits, via Wyoming State Geological Survey
filter: Uses contains DOM_GW and no IRR_GW/IND_GW/MUN_GW/CBM/MON/TST (DOM_GW with STK/MIS allowed); deduped on permit number+prefix+suffix

dataset: Kansas Geological Survey WWC5 water well records
filter: WELL_TYPE_CATEGORY='Domestic' (USE_DESC Domestic; Domestic+Lawn/Garden; Domestic+Livestock; Domestic changed from ...)
